system.description:
At the start of your turn during a conflict, if you have no martial armor equipped, you may spend 1 Fabula Point to immediately perform up to three different dances among those you know, in the order you prefer and without paying their MP cost. If you do, you cannot perform dances in any way until the end of your next turn.

You Spend: @LOSS[1 fp]
You Suffer: @EFFECT[Compendium.projectfu.heroic-skills.Item.WJD7tqc73P24UFg4]
